question:
dentify the error in the sentence.

She danced graceful on stage during the annual show.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**graceful**" is an adjective, but the sentence requires an adverb to describe the manner of dancing.
 
• Adverbs are used to modify verbs, adjectives, or other adverbs, and in this case, it should describe the verb "**danced**."
 
• The correct adverb form of the word is "**gracefully**."
 
• Thus, the error lies in the usage of "**graceful**" instead of "**gracefully**."

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"She danced **gracefully** on stage during the annual show."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Stage:** The word "**stage**" is correctly used in the sentence and does not require any changes.
 
• **Show:** The word "**show**" is also correctly used and does not require any changes.
 
• **During:** The preposition "**during**" is appropriate in this context and does not require any changes.
